details:
I cannot recommend enough that the VR chat team, for both Android beta and PC/quest/all versions, implement a goodbye setting. This isn't an animation or anything. It's just a setting that allows the user to toggle it to five or 10 seconds. If it's set at 5 seconds, and the user selects to join another world, accepts an invite, or quits the game, it gives a 5 second countdown from when you select that world or option. You already have the asset for the countdown; just use the same one from the camera. It's perfect. Have that flash in the bottom third of the screen, allowing the user to craft their exact exit, instead of standing there awkwardly holding your menu when you disappear. How much of how you feel about someone is informed by your last impressions of them? I'm telling you, this would be an absolute freaking game changer, and from what I can see, most of it would not be that difficult to implement. 

Anyways, I'm glad I finally got to tell you guys about that because, man, have I always wanted to craft my own exit. 

Maybe a classic Lori Petty: welp, it's been swell, but the swelling's going down. 

If you do implement it, please feel free to send me some of your favorite sign-offs 

Love you guys.
title: I've been holding on to this idea for nearly 2 years now
